claims.text: Grammatical correctness is evaluated by identifying POS tags for each sentence and checking for matching sequences across the corpus.
The manual evaluation of grammatical correctness scored an average of 2.3 out of 3, indicating a high level of correctness.
The automatic evaluation corroborates the manual evaluation results, confirming the overall grammatical correctness is very good.
